name: Barcelona, Spain

visa.notes: Non-lucrative visa requires proof of sufficient funds (~€2,400/mo). Cannot work in Spain on this visa.

rent.notes: idealista Oct 2026: Barcelona city EUR 20.5/m2 (+0.3% y/y, flat under Catalonia rent caps); 80-95 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR = EUR 1,640-1,950. Numbeo Feb 2026: 3BR EUR 1,631 outside centre (1,200-2,500), EUR 2,162 centre. Pet-friendly supply is scarce; max covers central or seasonal (temporada) contracts.

sources.title: idealista: El precio del alquiler en Espana sube un 5,6% interanual en octubre 2026
Numbeo: Cost of Living in Barcelona (Feb 2026)

groceries.notes: OCU 2026 study: average Spanish household basket EUR 6,602/yr (EUR 550/mo), with Catalonia among the most expensive regions; food CPI +2.3% y/y Aug 2026. Add about EUR 60-80/mo of food for a 100 lb dog (large-dog upkeep starts near EUR 100/mo, Hola/vet estimate).

sources.title: idealista/news: OCU 2026 supermarket price study
MAPA: Serie IPC alimentos informe n.16 (agosto 2026)

utilities.notes: Electricity: PVPC average bill EUR 88/mo at 3,500 kWh/yr in Oct 2026 (+26% y/y); 2-3BR flat with some A/C and winter heating about EUR 100-115. Gas/butane EUR 20-25. Aigues de Barcelona water for a 2-person home (6 m3/mo) is among Spain's priciest, about EUR 35 incl. sewer and waste levies after the 2.9% 2026 rise. Numbeo basic utilities EUR 156 (100-283). Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Resident retiree couple age 60 on private full-cover policies (required for the non-lucrative visa; pre-existing conditions can be loaded or excluded). Poliza Medica Nov 2026 market average at age 60: EUR 91/person full cover with copays, EUR 123/person no-copay; Sanitas Mas Salud 60-64 no-copay EUR 186 (Valencia) to EUR 220 (Barcelona) per person. Typical = 2 x EUR 123; after 1 year of legal residency the public SNS becomes an option via the convenio especial (not priced here). Max uses Sanitas Barcelona 60-64 no-copay EUR 220 x2.

insurance.notes: Renters/contents (seguro de inquilino) policy only: Selectra quotes EUR 70-300/yr (Tuio 79, Caser 110, Santalucia 141 for a 71 m2 flat); full owner-type home policies average about EUR 265/yr nationally (Selectra 2026 report), used as the upper bound. Typical about EUR 140/yr. Re-modeled from old template (stored 140 was health cover). Barcelona capital average home premium EUR 295/yr.

sources.title: Selectra: seguro para inquilinos precios
Selectra: Informe seguros de hogar 2026 (prima media por capital)

petCare.notes: Large dog, no food: annual vaccines incl. rabies EUR 50-80, 2 consults EUR 30-60 each, monthly antiparasitic pipette EUR 8-15 plus quarterly worming EUR 12-20, periodic dental cleaning EUR 100-250 (cuantomecuesta, Apr 2026); giant-breed dosing and Bernese health risks push the typical above the EUR 200-400/yr healthy-pet estimate.

petDaycare.notes: Occasional use: about 6-8 daycare days per month at the Cronoshare national average EUR 16/day (range 9-30) plus one week of boarding per year. Barcelona has many commercial daycares (guarderias caninas) so the lower end is realistic.

sources.title: Cronoshare: guarderia canina precios

petGrooming.notes: Giant long/double coat: bath EUR 42-47, brush-out EUR 20-24, tidy-up EUR 46-51 per visit (Cronoshare 2026 national price guide); modeled as one full groom per month with a brush-out in between.

sources.title: Cronoshare: cuanto cuesta peluqueria canina (precios 2026)

transportation.notes: Transit-first city: T-usual 1 zone EUR 22.80/30 days (50% state discount kept for 2026 per ATM), two passes = EUR 46. A car adds insurance EUR 394/yr (CHECK24), fuel at EUR 1.73/l, maintenance and expensive parking; typical assumes passes plus a lightly used car or car-sharing, max a garaged car.

entertainment.notes: Home fibre 1 Gbps EUR 20-30 (Digi; Numbeo city average EUR 26-33) plus about EUR 35 streaming, 4 mid-range meals for two at about EUR 60 (Numbeo), and EUR 40-70 activities. Barcelona meal for two EUR 60 (40-90); internet EUR 33 average.

phoneCell.notes: Two local lines: Digi 50 GB unlimited calls EUR 7/line, 100 GB EUR 10, unlimited EUR 12 (Kelisto, Oct 2026; Digi froze prices for 2026); Numbeo city average for a 10 GB+ plan is about EUR 17/line. Stored value included a US Google Fi line; add roughly EUR 45/mo if that line is kept.

healthcare.system: CatSalut (Catalan public health) with world-class hospitals like Hospital Clínic. Extensive private options.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-10 weeks for specialists. Private: under 2 weeks.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public covers most prescriptions; retirees get reduced co-pays

pros: World-class culture, architecture, food, and nightlife
Excellent metro and public transit system

cons.text: High cost of living, especially rent
Pickpocketing and petty crime in tourist areas
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country
